recentItems.description:
The iconic Narayanguda Sadar festival in Hyderabad is all set for grand celebrations on November 10th featuring extraordinary special bull breeds. Top attraction bulls including Yuvraju, Kali, and Rolex are ready to mesmerize the crowd during this year's vibrant Sadar Sammelan celebrations. A total of seven massive and specially trained bulls have been brought in to showcase their incredible size, strength, and traditional charm.
